source.title: Queensland government arrangements directory—supplier procurement arrangements
source.source_reliability_basis: Uncalibrated government-source prior; uniform, not claimed measured
source.description: A directory of supplier procurement arrangements across the Queensland Government for the supply of goods and services that provides high level information about the arrangements.
source.temporal_warning: Resource/catalogue modification time is a publication proxy, not a verified record statement time

mappings.rationale: Sample rows show explicit labelled supplier ABNs in the form 'ABN: 39109383593'. The prior regex used (?i) and \s and \b, which the execution flagged as exceeding the regex input/pattern limit on a very long multi-party cell. This replacement uses a literal label and a fixed-width character class with no case-insensitive flag, no \s and no \b, and is applied per-cell with all:true so each labelled ABN is isolated. Zero held-out emissions were produced by the previous pattern, so the pattern itself has not been validated on the failing cell; confidence is held at 0.7 pending checksum validation and a rerun. Checksum validity is unverified in the training counts (checksum_valid_abn 0 for all fields reflects no ABN-labelled matches in training check output, not a failure). Only supplier ABNs in Suppliers are mapped; Department, Section and Contact fields are buyer/agency and are excluded.

Publication state of the directory record, not an address state.
Arrangement status, not the supplier's entity status.
Government buyer contact; not a supplier attribute.
Government buyer contact; not a supplier attribute.
Buying agency; must not be mapped as supplier identity or address.
Buying agency unit; not supplier data.
Compound free text. Only the ABN-labelled identifier path is mapped. Supplier names, trading names, addresses, phones and emails cannot be safely attributed by index and remain unmapped.

warnings: Execution produced 0 observations. Per-field validation shows 13 valid emissions for Suppliers->entity.abn alongside 1 error on a very long cell, so the path did emit in part; the observation_count of 0 is inconsistent with per_field_validation and should be investigated in the runtime.
The previous regex used (?i), \s and \b; the replacement avoids these constructs and uses a literal label with a character class.

Confidence 0.7 is below minimum_field_confidence 0.8, so this mapping will be filtered out at the configured threshold until checksum validation and a successful rerun on the long cell are obtained. Coverage is sparse: most sample rows have no labelled ABN.
Checksum validity of extracted ABNs is unverified; the 'abn' transform is assumed to perform checksum validation.
The 'Suppliers' list contains buyer-unrelated free text. Names are not mapped because they cannot be reliably paired with ABNs by index.
observed_at_field is null; resource_last_modified_proxy is only a publication proxy, not a statement time.
No ACN or NZBN mapped; no ACN inferred from ABN. Review status pending.
